attackers_goals: Attackers might use well-known email ports as a C&C channel to evade detection and firewall rules.
description: These methods are used by malware and attackers to leak data and remain undetected.
investigative_actions: Check whether the initiator process is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Check whether additional malicious commands were executed from the same process.
name: Rare communication over email ports to external email server by unsigned process
